## [1.0.7] (2026-10-07)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **crash:** decouple custom settings and hooks from upstream Morphe classes to prevent startup collisions
* **members:** seamlessly append MembersVideoFilter to Litho filter array for multi-source compatibility
* **audiofocus:** isolate Shorts overlay listener into SmartAudioFocusManager without MainActivity hooks
